name: use-filter-bar
title: useFilterBar
description: Hook that manages the state plumbing between FilterDropdown.Composed and AppliedFilters.Root — local selections, apply, remove, reset, and sync with committed filter state.

docs.lead: A React hook that eliminates the boilerplate of wiring FilterDropdown and AppliedFilters together. It manages local working selections, syncs them with committed filter state, and provides handlers for apply, remove, and reset — so the page only needs to define filter configs and plug in the returned props.
docs.usage:
import { useFilterBar } from "@/hooks/use-filter-bar"

const filterBar = useFilterBar({
  filterKeys: ['status', 'category', 'assignee'],
  filters,
  setFilters,
  setPage,
})

examples.title: Basic Usage with FilterDropdown and AppliedFilters
examples.description: Wire the hook's return values directly to FilterDropdown.Composed and AppliedFilters.Root props.

api.name: useFilterBar
api.description: Hook that manages filter state plumbing between a filter dropdown and applied filters display.

props.name: filterKeys
props.description: The keys from the filter state object that this hook manages. Each key must hold a string[] value.

props.name: filters
props.description: The committed filter state object (e.g. from context or URL params).

props.name: setFilters
props.description: State setter for the committed filters.

props.name: setPage
props.description: Optional page setter. Called with 1 after every apply, remove, or reset.

api.name: UseFilterBarReturn
api.description: Return value of the useFilterBar hook.

props.name: selections
props.description: Local working selections. Pass to FilterDropdown.Composed `selected` prop.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Pass to FilterDropdown.Composed `onApply` prop. Commits selections to filter state.

props.name: applied
props.description: Applied filter values derived from committed state. Pass to AppliedFilters.Root `selected` prop.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Removes a single value from an applied filter. Pass to AppliedFilters.Root `onRemove` prop.

props.name: onResetAll
props.description: Clears all managed filter keys. Pass to AppliedFilters.Root `onResetAll` prop.

props.name: hasAppliedFilters
props.description: Whether any managed filters currently have applied values.
